name: Larkspur docs
description: Larkspur's docs, the modules they cover, who owns each module, and where the docs and the owners run out.

module.label: {path}
module.description: A workspace directory with its own package.json, under services/, packages/ or tools/.

path.description: The directory, from the repository root.

area.description: Which workspace folder it sits in.

readme.label: README
readme.description: Its own README.md, if it has one.

doc.label: {title}
doc.description: A Markdown file under docs/ (outside the decision records) or the repository's README.

path.description: The file, from the repository root.

lastReviewed.label: Last reviewed
lastReviewed.description: The date on its Last reviewed line.

decision.label: ADR {number}: {title}
decision.description: A numbered decision record under docs/adr/.

path.description: The file, from the repository root.

wholeRepository.label: Affects the whole repository
wholeRepository.description: Its Affects line names the whole repository rather than modules.

affects.description: the modules its Affects line names

add-module.title: Add a module
add-module.description: Record a workspace directory with its own package.json.

add-doc.title: Add a doc
add-doc.description: Record a Markdown file under docs/.

add-decision.title: Add a decision record
add-decision.description: Record a numbered decision under docs/adr/.

take-module-owner.title: Take an owner off the module
take-module-owner.description: Say this person no longer reviews this module.

take-doc-owner.title: Take an owner off the doc
take-doc-owner.description: Say this person no longer reviews this doc.

document-in.title: Point it at a doc
document-in.description: Say which doc covers this module.

cover-module.title: Say which module it covers
cover-module.description: Name a module this doc covers.

undocument-in.title: Take a doc off it
undocument-in.description: Say this doc no longer covers this module.
undocument-in.fromTheOtherEnd: Say it no longer covers a module

add-affected.title: Name a module it affects
add-affected.description: Add a module to its Affects line.
add-affected.fromTheOtherEnd: Name a decision that affects it

remove-affected.title: Take a module off it
remove-affected.description: Take a module off its Affects line.

supersede.title: Say what it supersedes
supersede.description: Name the earlier decision this one replaces.

unsupersede.title: Take back what it supersedes
unsupersede.description: Say this decision no longer replaces that one.

mark-superseded.title: Mark it superseded
mark-superseded.description: Mark the decision superseded by a later one.

doc-covers-a-module.title: Every guide, runbook and API doc covers a module

superseded-has-successor.title: A superseded decision names its successor
superseded-has-successor.says: {title} is marked superseded but no record supersedes it
